record.paper_title: Open Problems on Eigenvalues of the Laplacian
record.original_question: If Ω ⊂ ℝⁿ is a bounded convex domain and 0 = μ₀ < μ₁ ≤ μ₂ ≤ ··· are the Neumann eigenvalues of the Laplacian on Ω, must the ratio μ₂/μ₁ always satisfy μ₂/μ₁ ≤ 4?

evidence.quote: For Ω ⊂ ℝⁿ and convex, show μ₂/μ₁ ≤ 4.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ be a bounded convex domain, and let
$$0 = \mu_0(\Omega) < \mu_1(\Omega) \le \mu_2(\Omega) \le \mu_3(\Omega) \le \cdots$$
denote the eigenvalues (counted with multiplicity) of the Laplace operator $-\Delta$ on $\Omega$ with homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions, i.e. the values $\mu$ for which there exists a nonzero function $u \in H^1(\Omega)$ satisfying
$$-\Delta u = \mu u \text{ in } \Omega, \qquad \frac{\partial u}{\partial \nu} = 0 \text{ on } \partial \Omega,$$
where $\nu$ is the outward unit normal. Prove or disprove: for every bounded convex domain $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^n$,
$$\frac{\mu_2(\Omega)}{\mu_1(\Omega)} \le 4.$$
artifact.status_search_result: A direct search did not return a proof or disproof of the bound $\mu_2/\mu_1 \le 4$ for bounded convex domains. The problem is listed as an open problem on eigenvalues of the Laplacian, and recent related work (e.g., on optimization and simplicity of the second Neumann eigenvalue on planar convex domains) treats nearby questions without resolving this ratio bound. No solution appears in the located literature.

status_evidence.title: A note on optimization of the second positive Neumann eigenvalue for parallelograms
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on the second Neumann eigenvalue for planar convex domains, related to conjectures on its optimization.
status_evidence.claim: Related work on the second Neumann eigenvalue exists but does not resolve the ratio bound μ₂/μ₁ ≤ 4 for convex domains.

status_evidence.title: On domain monotonicity of Neumann eigenvalues of convex domains
status_evidence.snippet: Recent study of Neumann eigenvalues on convex domains.
status_evidence.claim: Recent literature on Neumann eigenvalues of convex domains does not establish the conjectured ratio bound.
